name: heat_pump_room_cop
title: Heat pump heating a room: power from COP (exercise)
summary: A heat pump with COP 2.5 heats 800 kg of air. The temperature rise is written as 32 - 20, the heat uses c_v, and the heating rate over 15 minutes gives the power. Teaching exercise Cengel 6-44.
